versePreview_en: “Do not merely listen to the word…”

text_en: Genuine faith becomes visible. We are not saved by works, but living faith produces obedience, compassion, and action.
versePreview_en: “…faith by itself, if it is not accompanied by action, is dead.”

text_en: The same mouth should not worship God while continually destroying people made in His image. Spiritual maturity includes surrendering our speech to Christ.
versePreview_en: “…this should not be.”

text_en: Spiritual resistance begins with surrender. Draw near to God, resist the devil, and refuse to give the enemy authority that belongs to Christ.
versePreview_en: “Submit yourselves, then, to God…”

text_en: God calls His people into honest, prayerful community. Do not merely talk about someone’s struggle—pray for them.
versePreview_en: “…pray for each other…”

text_en: Because Jesus rose from the dead, Christian hope is alive. Our future rests upon the risen Christ.
versePreview_en: “…he has given us new birth into a living hope…”

text_en: God gives His people both identity and mission. We belong to Him so that our lives can declare His goodness to a world still living in darkness.
versePreview_en: “…a royal priesthood, a holy nation, God’s special possession…”

text_en: Be ready to explain the hope you have in Jesus, but do it with gentleness and respect. Evangelism is not about winning arguments; it is about faithfully pointing people toward Christ.
versePreview_en: “…always be prepared to give an answer…”

theme_en: USE YOUR GIFT TO SERVE OTHERS
text_en: Whatever God has entrusted to you is intended for stewardship. Gifts become Kingdom tools when they are used to serve people.
versePreview_en: “…use whatever gift you have received to serve others…”

text_en: Spiritual authority is stewardship, not ownership. Kingdom leaders care for God’s people willingly and lead by example rather than domination.
versePreview_en: “Be shepherds of God’s flock…”

text_en: God does not ask you to carry every burden alone. Bring your worries to the Father because His care for you is real.
versePreview_en: “Cast all your anxiety on him because he cares for you.”

text_en: There is always more room to grow. Continue knowing Jesus more deeply while allowing His grace to shape your life.
versePreview_en: “…grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord…”

text_en: Following Jesus means refusing a hidden double life. Bring sin into God’s light, receive cleansing, and walk honestly with Him and His people.
versePreview_en: “…if we walk in the light…”

text_en: Followers of Jesus do not need to pretend they never fail. Confession brings our sin honestly before the faithful and forgiving God.
versePreview_en: “If we confess our sins…”

text_en: Your deepest identity is not your occupation, accomplishments, failures, possessions, or reputation. Through Christ, you belong to the Father.
versePreview_en: “…that we should be called children of God!”

text_en: Kingdom love becomes tangible. Do not merely tell people that you care; look for practical opportunities to demonstrate it.
versePreview_en: “…not love with words or speech but with actions…”

text_en: Not everything presented as spiritual originates from God. Disciples need discernment grounded in Scripture and centered upon the truth about Jesus Christ.
versePreview_en: “…test the spirits…”

text_en: God’s love is not an abstract idea. He demonstrated it by sending His Son so that sinful humanity could receive life through Him.
versePreview_en: “…God showed his love among us…”

text_en: As we become secure in the Father’s love, fear loses its ability to control our relationship with Him.
versePreview_en: “There is no fear in love…”

text_en: Build your faith, pray in the Holy Spirit, remain rooted in God’s love, and keep your hope fixed upon Jesus.
versePreview_en: “…keep yourselves in God’s love…”

text_en: It is possible to work for Jesus while allowing our love for Jesus to grow cold. Return continually to the relationship from which everything else flows.
versePreview_en: “…you have forsaken the love you had at first.”

text_en: Jesus calls His people away from spiritual complacency and back into fellowship with Him. Hear His voice and open every area of your life to His lordship.
versePreview_en: “Here I am! I stand at the door and knock.”

text_en: This is where global evangelism is heading. God’s redeemed family will include people from every nation, tribe, people, and language gathered before His throne.
versePreview_en: “…every nation, tribe, people and language…”

theme_en: OVERCOME BY THE LAMB AND YOUR TESTIMONY
text_en: Our victory rests first in what Jesus accomplished. Our testimony then declares what the Lamb has done. Never underestimate the power of telling others how Christ changed your life.
versePreview_en: “…the blood of the Lamb and by the word of their testimony…”

text_en:
Jesus came first as the suffering Savior, but Scripture points toward His return as victorious King. Our hope is not ultimately in governments, economies, institutions, or human leaders. Our hope is Jesus Christ.

Live ready. Remain faithful. Keep your lamp burning. The King is coming.
versePreview_en: “…Faithful and True…” “…KING OF KINGS AND LORD OF LORDS.”

text_en:
We began this journey with an invitation to encounter Jesus. We finish it looking toward His return.

For 365 days, we have walked through the Gospel: Come and see. Repent and believe. Follow Jesus. Be born again. Receive the Holy Spirit. Abide in Christ. Love one another. Make disciples. Use what God has given you. Serve His people. Carry the Gospel to the nations. Remain faithful. Prepare for the King.

But Day 365 is not graduation from following Jesus.

It is another beginning.

Keep knowing the Father. Keep following the Son. Keep walking in the Holy Spirit. Keep loving people. Keep serving. Keep forgiving. Keep praying. Keep sharing the Gospel. Keep making disciples. Keep watching for the King.

And until He comes, may the prayer of the Church remain:

Come, Lord Jesus.
versePreview_en: “Look, I am coming soon!” “Amen. Come, Lord Jesus.”
